name: Lucifer, Morningstar Thronebreaker
loreTies: Lucifer embodies morningstar pride, infernal sovereignty, rebellion, and throne-breaking ambition within The Infernal Dominion.
The Black-Iron Gate allows this deity to enter Ascension-era dungeon routes without collapsing the individuality of other Realms.
Infernal Dominion culture, symbols, weapons, and divine law shape every ability, artifact, silhouette, and combat choice.
shortBackstory: Lucifer, Morningstar Thronebreaker, is a playable god in Mythos Gates: Ascension. Lucifer is the true source-realm divinity behind the mythology — morningstar pride, infernal sovereignty, rebellion, and throne-breaking ambition. Ascension expands divine power during the current Gate crisis; it does not turn a mortal into a god.

chapters.title: Divine Origin
chapters.text: Lucifer is not a mortal hero inspired by myth. Lucifer is the actual god recognized by Infernal Dominion source culture, born from the supernatural laws of The Infernal Dominion. Their domain — morningstar pride, infernal sovereignty, rebellion, and throne-breaking ambition — determines their symbols, weapons, posture, combat instincts, and relationship to sacred authority.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Within Infernal Dominion, Lucifer expresses the civilization rather than merely representing it. Their visual identity must carry the materials, beauty standards, divine symbols, and sacred rules of The Infernal Dominion. Their gameplay role, Defender, must grow from mythology first and mechanics second.

chapters.title: Mythos Gate Wound
chapters.text: During the Ascension era, Lucifer can interact with The Black-Iron Gate because divine beings are intrinsically connected to their Realms. The Gate does not become a simple teleportation portal; it is a mysterious boundary where separate mythological realities become traversable. Lucifer understands some rites of crossing, but not the complete origin of the Mythos Gates.

chapters.title: Dungeon Role
chapters.text: When selected by the player, Lucifer enters the dungeon alone as one god or goddess against multiple enemies. No army follows. No squad shares control. Every room, trap, shrine, relic, elite, and boss encounter must test how morningstar pride, infernal sovereignty, rebellion, and throne-breaking ambition survives pressure from creatures, rival Realm laws, and unstable Gate conditions.

chapters.title: Ascension Conflict
chapters.text: Ascension is the current story arc, not the permanent end-state of the Mythos Gates universe. For Lucifer, Ascension means restoration, awakening, evolution, or expansion of existing divine power. Their personal conflict is to recover strength without reducing Infernal Dominion mythology into raw fuel for the crisis.

relationshipHooks: Faction witnesses interpret how Lucifer crosses The Black-Iron Gate.
Rival deities challenge the limits of cross-Realm travel.
Dungeon lore pickups reveal Gate mystery without resolving the full origin.
developmentStatus: Playable deity backstory aligned to Mythos Gates identity, one-deity dungeon runs, current Ascension arc, and preserved Lore Codex canon.
mythicSource: source culture humans later copied as hell, demonology, and infernal contract lore
visualCanon: Vasha is a cinder-broker of contract law. Her ash velvet, black-iron jewelry, blood-wax seals, coin-chain tools, and too-calm smile should feel like the origin of later devil-bargain folklore.
title: Morningstar Thronebreaker

mythosGatesCanon.identityRule: Lucifer is the actual god of Infernal Dominion source mythology, never a mortal hero or generic champion.
mythosGatesCanon.arcRule: Ascension restores, awakens, evolves, or expands existing divine power; it does not make the character a god for the first time.
mythosGatesCanon.mysteryRule: The backstory may reveal how this deity interacts with the Mythos Gates, but must not resolve the full origin of the Gates.
